# Winnow prompt fixtures

Adapted from Ollaya `crates/ollaya-decision/tests/fixtures/winnow_prompts.jsonl`, commit `f42c89eb7436cfd0f02c582b54b182727118e438` (https://github.com/ollaya-dev/ollaya).
Twelve text requests were converted to the L2S1 typed schema; expected prefix/suffix strings are preserved. Used only for prompt regression checks, not benchmark training or selection. The upstream fixture and classification prompt are Apache-2.0 licensed; see [license](OLLaya-LICENSE).
